content.title: Version 1.0 → Version 1.1
content.subtitle: How to Upgrade Your Current Version!
content.body:
We live in a time when a new version of something is released almost every day. Phone software gets updated, new technology arrives, systems improve. Everyone wants the latest version. But have you ever asked yourself—when was the last time you created a new version of yourself?

For many of us, plans for change begin with an impossible expectation. We want to become a different person tomorrow. Irregular in Salah today, Tahajjud from tomorrow. A weak relationship with the Qur’an today, several pages of recitation from tomorrow. Wasting time today, a routine from tomorrow.

Where is the problem?

The problem is not wanting change; it is our expectations. We want to go directly from Version 1.0 to Version 10.0. But life does not change this way. Real change happens quietly.

Small Changes, Big Impact

Offering one Salah on time today, trying to offer it in congregation tomorrow. Reading the Qur’an for five minutes today, perhaps ten minutes tomorrow. Stopping yourself from saying a harsh word today. Taking ten minutes for your family today, making it more meaningful tomorrow.

Every small change is a small update.

Version 1.0... → Version 1.1... → Version 1.2... → Version 1.3...

These changes may seem small. But over time, these small updates change a person’s character, habits, and life.

What Does Islam Teach?

The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said,

“The most beloved deed to Allah is that which is done consistently, even if it is small.”

— Sahih al-Bukhari, Hadith: 6465; Sahih Muslim, Hadith: 782

So, let your Version 1.1 begin today.

In the journey of changing yourself, do not rush; consistency is needed. Allah has not required perfect work or perfect results; rather, He loves sincere effort. So, think—what could my next version be? Perhaps one small change today could be the biggest update of your tomorrow.
